rules.statement: A daughter who accepts a dowry after her mother's death does not lose her right to the acquired property of her deceased mother, as provided by section 20(2) of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance in its pre-amended form.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under the Thesavalamai, a daughter who was given a dowry on her marriage that took place after the death of her mother did not, by accepting the dowry, lose her right to her share of her deceased mother's thediatheddam which vested in her by operation of section 20 (2) of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance in the form in which it stood prior to its amendment by section 6 of Ordinance No. 58 of 1947."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance (prior to amendment by s. 6 of Ordinance No. 58 of 1947), s. 20 (2)
